CHARACTER ROOM / 0.17.0

Take your time

Use these two rooms to judge the character’s shape, movement, and scale. The doorway on the right leads to three resetting practice targets. Equip weapons in Gear. Aim with the right stick or mouse; tap Throw to toss the selected grenade ahead. Practice reserves are unlimited.

On iPhone, use Share → Add to Home Screen, then open the new icon. Turn your phone sideways for more room.
